# Holdr (FinanceTracker)

> Holdr is a self-hosted personal finance app for one U.S. household: investments (brokerage, Roth IRA, 401(k), HSA),
> physical gold and silver, everyday credit-card spending, card benefits and statement credits, and spending forecasts.
> It runs on the owner's Windows or macOS computer with a local SQLite database, listens on 127.0.0.1 only, and has no
> telemetry.

The web app is for people. AI agents read Holdr through the read-only MCP server in `agents/mcp` (nine tools: portfolio,
positions, investment activity, gold and silver, spending summary, card transactions, card benefits, spending forecast,
health) or through the loopback REST API, both with Holdr's agent token (`<data folder>/agent-token`), which Holdr
allows GET and HEAD on a reviewed list of read routes and nothing else. Both work only on the computer that runs Holdr;
never expose Holdr to the internet, and never give an agent the service token (`service-token`), which can change data.
Experiment with the synthetic demo (`npm run demo`; API on 127.0.0.1:4001) rather than a real household's data.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): what Holdr does, the privacy model, requirements, the demo, quick start, imports, phone access through Tailscale Serve, backups
- [Getting started](docs/getting-started.md): installing Holdr on Windows or macOS and running it with your own data, step by step
- [The demo](docs/demo.md): `npm run demo`, a fictional household with its own data folder and ports, offline
- [Use Holdr with AI agents](docs/agents.md): the read-only agent token, the MCP server's tools, setup for GitHub Copilot CLI, VS Code, Claude Desktop and Cursor, the REST API, the security model, token rotation, limitations
- [Architecture and limitations](docs/architecture.md): components, storage, authentication, networking, privacy boundaries
- [Deployment](docs/deployment.md): development, single computer, private HTTPS for your devices, the hardened macOS deployment, settings, backups, upgrades
- [Importing data](docs/importing-data.md): offline converters and preview-first imports for cards, checking, receipts and gold and silver
- [Card sync agent](docs/sync-agent.md): the experimental American Express statement receiver and browser extension
- [Documentation index](docs/README.md): every guide, grouped by task
